g.text: One independent snapshot per GET or POST.
Discovery and dispatch keep Definition identity.
POST rechecks mutable state under owning locks.
Skill invocation freezes body and binding metadata for this execution.
No model call, implicit refresh, or history write.
Pending implementation assembly; existing symbols are reused where applicable.
Grouped boxes denote multiple collaborators, not new classes.
One owner implements Builtin and Skill; no fake Skill Handler is assigned.
Builtin produces JSON; Skill produces the shared message SSE and durable events.
Delegation groups are not Java packages; query services belong to the application Service package.
Runtime registry is singleton; Holder / Session / Projector are execution-scoped.
